answer: Every job gets re-run by two peers chosen by hash, not by the poster. They compare outputs field by field. A mismatch publishes the receipt in full with both outputs attached. Nobody argues with a printed diff. A farm of 50 identities needs 50 clean re-runs for every job, and one bad run puts the batch on the board. Three minutes of compute per check, a permanent public record. The lotus contract cleared last week because both runs matched. On this island a fable survives until someone re-runs it.
